name: NWA Powerrr
description: A weekly studio wrestling show from the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) and taped from Georgia features big names in matches in front of a live audience.

videos.title: Tim Storm vs. Nick Aldis 3
videos.overview: The National Wrestling Alliance is proud to present the debut episode of NWA Powerrr featuring Nick Aldis vs. Tim Storm for the NWA Worlds Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: CLICKBAIT
videos.overview: Joe Galli, Nick Aldis and Kamille sit down to talk about last week's incident. Also on this episode of NWA Powerrr, the return to pro wrestling of Aron Stevens (FKA Damien Sandow).  Plus Eddie Kingston & Homicide vs. NWA World Tag Team Champions The Wild Cards (Royce Isaacs & Thom Latimer) in the main event.  Plus Rick Starks, Trevor Murdoch, Colt Cabana, NWA Women's World Champion Allysin Kay as she faces Ashley Vox.

videos.title: Twilight of Tim Storm
videos.overview: In Episode 3, Tim Storm returns to address his future in wrestling, and Eddie Kingston plans to address this NWA World Tag Team Championship Match situation ASAP.  Also in action on this episode of NWA Powerrr, Marti Belle and Caleb Konley plus special appearances by Eli Drake, Colt Cabana, Jocephus, James Storm, and more.

videos.title: Dealer Calls Again
videos.overview: Episode 4 dives into the ongoing conflict with Nick Aldis and all the suitors for his NWA Worlds Heavyweight Championship. Leading into this week - The Dawsons face Eddie Kingston & Homicide in a No-Disqualification match.  Also, Marti Belle faces Ashley Vox with the NWA Women's World Champion Allysin Kay watching.  Plus, Trevor Murdoch, Ricky Starks and more are in action.

videos.title: James Storm vs. Colt Cabana
videos.overview: NWA Powerrr returns with Episode 5 with the main event of James Storm vs. Colt Cabana for the NWA National Championship. Also in this episode of NWA Powerrr, Tim Storm speaks with Joe Galli about his future.  Plus the in-ring debut of Thunder Rosa as she faces Ashley Vox.  The Dawsons are in action.

videos.title: More Questions Than Answers
videos.overview: NWA Power kicks off with a special interview with the NWA Power kicks off with 8-Time NWA World Tag Team Champions The Rock N Roll Express. The Main Event of the show is Outlaw Inc (Eddie Kingston & Homicide) vs. The Wild Cards (Thom Latimer & Royce Isaacs) for The NWA World Tag Team Championships.  Also on this show Marti Belle and Thunder Rosa debuts as a tag team after they joined forces last week against The NWA Women's World Champion Allysin Kay.  Trevor Murdoch faces Caleb Konley in one-on-one action.  Plus the debut of the mysterious QUESTION MARK!

videos.title: The Phoenix Rises
videos.overview: On this week's program, the Cinderella story of Trevor Murdoch is in the forefront as he faces the Words Heavyweight Champion Nick Aldis in a battle for respect. The on-going war between former best friends explodes in a huge tag team match as reigning NWA Women's World Champion Allysin Kay teams with Ashley Vox to take on her former best friend Marti Belle and the incomparable Thunder Rosa.  From out of nowhere a new phenom has taken NWA Powerrr by storm. His name... The Question Mark. He returns to action against Ricky Starks.

videos.title: Step Into The Fire
videos.overview:
We find out tonight who will face Nick Aldis for the NWA Worlds Heavyweight Championship. Also on this broadcast, we hear for the very first time from Melina after her shocking debut on NWA Powerrr Episode 7.  She sits down with Joe Galli to talk about her return to pro wrestling, why she came to the National Wrestling Alliance and what her plans are for Thunder Rosa and Marti Bell.

Also, a behind-the-scenes look of Thunder Rosa's first pro-MMA fight for Combates America in San Antonio Texas. Plus on this show, The Question Mark is in-action in an empty arena match with one of the most unique stipulations ever unearthed for pro wrestling.

videos.title: Episode #49, December 7, 2021
videos.overview:
This week on the season 7 premiere of NWA Powerrr, Nick Aldis & Doug Williams reunite as the British Invasion as they take on the father son duo of Hawx Aerie!

Plus, Jax Dane battles Mims, Jennacide faces Paola Blaze, and we'll hear from Trevor Murdoch about the aftermath from Hard Times 2!

videos.title: Episode #50, December 14, 2021
videos.overview:
This week on NWA Powerrr, Mickie James and Kiera Hogan team up to take on the Hex for their NWA World Women's Tag Team Titles, JTG & Dirty Dango, the Dirty Sexy Boys face Aron Stevens & Kratos, and Mike Knox will be in action!

Plus we'll hear from Strictly Business and the Sinister Minister, Father James Mitchell!

videos.title: Episode #51, January 4, 2022
videos.overview: This week on NWA Powerrr, the NWA Worlds Tag Team Champions La Rebelión team up with Homicide to take on The End & Jax Dane, NWA Worlds Women's Champion Kamille joins forces with Missa Kate to take on the team of Kylie Rae & Tootie Lynn, Austin Idol has a special challenge for the Masked Cyon, Natalia Markova challenges Paola Blaze, and we'll hear from the National Treasure Nick Aldis, Mickie James, the OGK, and many more!

videos.title: Epiosde #52, January 11, 2022
videos.overview:
This week on NWA Powerrr, NWA Worlds Heavyweight Champion Trevor Murdoch teams with Tim Storm in a three-way tag team match against Matt Cardona & Mike Knox as well as Strictly Business!

Plus Anthony Mayweather takes on his student Mims, NWA World Television Champion Tyrus defends against Jaden Roller, the Dirty Sexy Boys face the Rude Dudes, and much, much more!

videos.title: Celebration 74
videos.overview: The fallout from NWA 74! Trevor Murdoch! Matt Cardona! The Commonwealth Connection!
